sources.label: Nest scoped on-chain liquid-reserve availability, reviewed 2026-10-07

reserveReview.rationale: An October 1, 2026 recheck of the exact nWISDOM positions API identifies xCRDYX, nTBILL and liquid stablecoin balances. WisdomTree issuer disclosure corroborates CRDYX exposure to publicly traded alternative-credit investment vehicles. The Nest available-vault directory fetched on that date does not list nWISDOM or verify the earlier four-day redemption estimate. The September 21 composition percentages and NAV reconciliation residual remain historical observations pending dated liability/asset reconciliation; the current API balances do not identify the residual or legal recovery waterfall. On 2026-10-07, the exact vault 0x29bf22381a5811dec89dc7b46a5ce57ad02c0240 positions API lists USDC, USDT/USDT0 and pUSD in liquidAssets with no pending transactions. Immediate liquidity describes only these scoped idle token categories, consistent with the issuer's on-chain liquid-reserve mechanics; it is not a bank USD, bridge unwind, whole-vault or stressed-settlement guarantee. The added keyed zero-percent USDT metadata row makes no assertion about its live weight and does not refresh the historical composition or classify the NAV residual.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live Nest positions and vault documentation, with the adapter's NAV reconciliation residual retained explicitly
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The WisdomTree CRDYX position is identified and classified. The adapter's 1% NAV reconciliation residual is not attributed to an asset, obligor, custody account, receivable, or valuation adjustment by the reviewed primary sources.
